# SealDrop

> End-to-end encrypted file exchange. Encrypt files in the browser, share a link, auto-delete after use. No account required.

SealDrop is a browser-based encrypted file exchange deployed at https://sealdrop.io. Files are encrypted client-side with AES-GCM-256 before upload. Decryption keys live in URL fragments, which browsers never send to servers.

## Key features

- Client-side encryption (AES-GCM-256, ECDH P-256, HKDF)
- Auto-delete on expiry (open-once, 1h, 1d, 7d)
- Send mode: encrypt and share a file link
- Receive mode: create a drop link, others encrypt files to your public key
- File size padding for privacy
- Optional passphrase protection
- Open-on-device handoff codes
- No account, no tracking, no cookies

## API

Base URL: `https://sealdrop.io/api`

- `POST /api/send/init` — initialize an upload, get pre-signed URL
- `POST /api/send/confirm` — confirm upload complete
- `GET /api/send/:fileId` — get file metadata (encrypted)
- `DELETE /api/send/:fileId` — delete a file
- `POST /api/receive/init` — create a drop link
- `GET /api/receive/:dropId` — get drop metadata
- `POST /api/receive/:dropId/claim` — mark drop consumed
- `POST /api/open-links` — create handoff code
- `GET /api/open-links/:id` — retrieve handoff payload
